_comment: The liveness matrix fixture (HM-799). Every band budget_core branches on is
present, and both of _liveness_note's REACHABLE return paths fire exactly
once (this skill passes prior_spend_key=None, so the 'spent only in the
prior window' path is unreachable by construction: documented in
budget_core, never invented here).
Campaigns 3 and 4 are a contrast pair: identical in every field except
'campaign_status'. That single field is what separates recently_active from
dormant, so each dormant gate is decidable. Both carry daily_budget 200,
which is below min_budget_multiple x target_cpa (5 x 50 = 250). budget_core
has THREE independent dormant gates and this fixture pins each of them
SEPARATELY -- no single deletion reproduces row 3:
(1) classify_row's gate: with it, row 4 has bucket ''; delete only it and
row 4 is bucketed 'Low budget' on a REMOVED campaign, the self-contradicting
headline HM-603 exists to prevent (its pace values are unchanged).
(2) the pace-ratio gate: with it, row 4 has campaign_pace_ratio null /
pace_verdict 'n/a' and stays out of summary.under_pace (3); delete only it
and row 4 paces 0.0 / 'under' and under_pace becomes 4.
(3) the pace-flag gate: with it, row 4 has pace_flags [] / pace_score 0.0;
delete only it and row 4 gets ['zero_conv'] / 2.0 -- NOT row 3's
['under_pace','zero_conv'] / 3.0, because gate (2) still forces row 4's pace
ratio to null, so under_pace cannot fire.
Only with ALL THREE deleted does row 4 reproduce row 3 exactly.
